items.title: Plugin configuration: a `plugins` table with options, enabled and replacedBy
Names: qualified plugin/name ids with short aliases and a rename map
Declarative extension points instead of 12 hard-coded kinds
Extending another plugin's types and fields: traits plus additive `extends`
Vocabulary sharing between plugins: declared `uses`, with roles as the target
External plugins: pinned sources, a CONTRACT version, and a frozen registry
Views return `{data, text()}`; checks, gates and views may be async

note: contract v2: the plugin-contract features, in dependency order
